from r

args.sql:
with c as (select customer, sum(subtotal) s from orders where ordered_at>='2025-01-01' and ordered_at<'2026-01-01' group by customer),
r as (select *, row_number() over (order by s desc) rn, count(*) over () n from c)
select max(n) n, ceil(max(n)*0.1) k, sum(s) filter (where rn<=ceil(n*0.1))*1.0/sum(s) as shr, count(*) filter (where customer is null) as nnull,
(select min(s) from r r2 where rn<=ceil(n*0.1)) as cut, (select count(*) from r r3 where s=(select min(s) from r r2 where rn<=ceil(n*0.1))) as tie_cnt, (select max(s) from r r4 where rn>ceil(n*0.1)) as next_s
from r
